parentId.description: Search within specific folder by folder ID (use "root" for My Drive root)

rawDriveQuery.description: Raw Google Drive query syntax for advanced use cases. Bypasses schema validation - use sparingly. Example: "name contains 'budget' and mimeType = 'application/pdf'"

sharedWithMe.description: Filter by "shared with me" collection (true = in shared collection, false = not shared)

starred.description: Filter by starred status (true = starred, false = not starred)

trashed.description: Filter by trash status (true = in trash, false = not in trash).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Omit for all fields. Available: id, name, mimeType, webViewLink, modifiedTime, parents, shared, starred, owners, path

pageSize.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 1000). Accepts numbers or numeric strings.

pageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results (drive format). Omit for first page.

query.description: Structured Drive query object or JSON string. Use rawDriveQuery for raw Drive syntax.

resolvePaths.description: Resolve full folder paths like /Work/Projects/2024 (requires additional API calls per result)

shape.description: Response shape: objects (keyed) or arrays (columnar, matching fields order)
